source_metadata.question:
Sets A and B, shown in the venn diagram, have the same number of elements. Thier union has 2007 elements and their intersection has 1001 elements. Find the number of elements in A.

<image1>
source_metadata.subject: algebra

target.visual_information: The lens-shaped region inside both circular outlines. On the left, use the narrow white lens simultaneously inside both green circles. On the right, use the central unshaded lens labeled 1001 inside both the A and B contours.
target.left_evidence: The narrow white lens simultaneously inside both green circles.
target.right_evidence: The central unshaded lens labeled 1001 inside both the A and B contours.
target.left_meaning: The lens consists of the elements common to A and B.
target.right_meaning: The lens contains elements shared by A and B, with cardinality 1001.
target.reason: The selected region lies within both labeled contours in each diagram, which assigns simultaneous membership in the two sets.
target.reasoning_consequence: Correctly interpreting the markings means reading the crossing contours as evidence that A and B overlap on the left and subtracting the shared 1001 elements when converting the sum of set sizes to union size on the right.
